description:
Run the one window that moves this repository, gf2, mealie-fi, inflected-messages and research to format 4, so the installed binary can leave the last format 3 build. The lead runs this, not a worker.

## Background

The installed `jit` is the last format 3 build, and all five repositories are at format 3. `dev/active/f8a6b298-history-independent-reads/format4-rewrite.py` and `format4-window.sh` are tested on copies of all five. The rewrite takes no jit write lock and relies on quiet.

gf2 has uncommitted paths inside and outside `.jit/`; its work outside `.jit/` stays untouched, and its `.jit` paths are committed by their owner before the window. A linked checkout's tracked `.jit` arrives by merging main, and leases in linked checkouts are covered by their repository's one rewrite.

## Who does what

The lead runs every step. Each write to another repository needs its own user confirmation when it runs, and live sessions must coordinate the binary reinstall first.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: With no tracker writer in any of the five repositories and the reinstall coordinated with live sessions, the old binaries are copied for rollback and `jit` and `jit-server` are installed from a commit whose `cargo-ci` passed.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each repository is rewritten, validated and committed by its own invocation of the driver, and each write to a repository other than this one has its own user confirmation.
- [hard] REQ-03: Afterward all five repositories' `index.json` read 4, `jit validate` passes in each, and each run id cited in `dev/`, `docs/` or an issue record in this repository still resolves.

## Notes

- A linked checkout on an older branch stays refused until it merges main and re-runs the script. Live sessions finish or merge before the window.
- A stop part-way leaves committed repositories at format 4, which the rollback binary refuses; the driver's message names them.
title: Five repositories move to repository format 4 in one window
